question: Which of the following countries won two ICC T20 World Cup Cricket titles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Indies.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• West Indies is the only country that won the ICC T20 World Cup twice **(2012 & 2016).**
 
• Seven tournaments have so far been played, and only the West Indies has won the tournament on multiple occasions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ICC T20 World Cup Winner & Runners List

 
 
• 2021 Winner. Australia. Captain : Aaron Finch.
 
• 2016 Winner. West Indies. Captain : Daren Sammy.
 
• 2014 Winner. Sri Lanka. Captain : Lasith Malinga.
 
• 2012 Winner. West Indies. Captain : Daren Sammy.
 
• 2010 Winner. England. Captain : Paul Collingwood.
 
• 2009 Winner. Pakistan. 
 
• 2007 Winner. India.
 
 
 
• The West Indies won the first two tournaments, Australia has won five, India has won two, while Pakistan, Sri Lanka and England have each won once.
 
• The West Indies (1975 and 1979) and Australia (1987, 1999, 2003, 2007 and 2015) are the only teams to have won consecutive titles.
 
• The ICC has its headquarters** in Dubai, UAE. **
 
• Shashank Manohar elected unopposed as ICC's first independent chairman. 
 
• Srinivasan became the first chairman **of ICC on 26 June 2014.**
